instruction: Help me to install Adwaita-dark theme from gnome-look.org and switch my GNOME desktop to use it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Adwaita-dark theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Adwaita-dark' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig command 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' correctly retrieves the GTK theme setting
check_list metric function correctly searches for the expected pattern 'Adwaita-dark' in the gsettings output file
Expected value 'Adwaita-dark' is semantically correct for verifying the theme is applied
Data flow is correct: postconfig executes command -> saves to cache file -> getter reads file -> metric searches for pattern
Evaluator verifies the end state (theme applied) which is the primary goal of the instruction

Minor consideration: Evaluator doesn't verify installation source (gnome-look.org) or installation step explicitly, only verifies final application state, but this is acceptable as you cannot apply a theme that isn't installed
